profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, trading under the ticker AUR, with SEC CIK 0001828108. Its website presents it as a self-driving freight company, with its autonomy work built around the Aurora Driver. The company describes the Aurora Driver as combining cutting-edge hardware with software backed by verifiable AI, and as a way to integrate the benefits of autonomy into a customer's fleet. It frames its stated aim as delivering self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The site carries testimonials from partners rather than named executives. One describes a pilot program that autonomously hauled freight between Fort Worth and El Paso, and a hybrid model pairing Werner professional drivers with the Aurora Driver. Another refers to a partnership with Volvo, whose Volvo VNL Autonomous has the Aurora Driver integrated into it. A further quote states that freight volumes are projected to grow five fold between 2010-2050, and another says the self-driving system has performed over millions of autonomous miles.

The company's litigation exposure is concentrated in Pennsylvania, where 137 matters are counted. No individual cases, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are listed for it.
